title: Closed loop basal won't go above profile setting
body:
I am on a closed loop. My profile basal is 0.90 U/h from 12am to 6am. My "Max U/h a Temp Basal can be set to" is set to 12.0 units.  However, ever since recently installing the Android 16 bluetooth hotfix, my loop appears to refuse to set a temp basal higher than my profile value. This has caused me to average 17 mmol/L for several nights. Any idea why my basal values are not being increased appropriately?

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/26d4dd96-6627-42d2-9d76-5f0e04ad6a88)

comments.body:
I don't know the root cause of the issue, but in case anyone else comes across this:
Re-importing settings and re-activating the profile appears to have fixed the issue.
